name: Early transport: the doorway claim
short_desc: A legacy note linked a large Linear Pottery doorway to wheeled transport. A doorway alone does not establish that wagons were in use.
long_desc: Construction of door for wagon entry
date_note: The imported 5000 BCE wagon-entry interpretation lacks a specific archaeological citation and is not plotted as an established transport milestone. The original statement is preserved in the archive.
notes: Background source added 24 October 2026. Existing date claims require specific source verification.
